create_diffquantizer: create a DiffQuantizer for a PyTorch model with configurable min and max bits for differentiable quantization
setup_optimizer: setup the optimizer to tune the number of bits with a specific learning rate for the DiffQuantizer
get_model_size: get a differentiable estimate of the quantized model size in MB using the model_size method
quantize_param: quantize a model parameter using uniform quantization with learned bit widths and noise injection
detach_quantizer: detach the DiffQuantizer from the model and remove all noise scale parameters
